hooks.command: F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; git check-ignore -q "$F" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; case "$F" in "$R"/*.py) "$R"/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix --unfixable F401,F841 --force-exclude "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1; "$R"/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --force-exclude "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; "$R"/*.md) "$R"/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --force-exclude "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$F" in "$R"/src/*.py) OUT=$(cd "$R" && .venv/bin/python -m mypy src/ 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+/(\s|\*|$|;)|rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+\*|rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+\.|rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+~'; then echo '❌ BLOCKED: rm -rf with dangerous target. Specify exact paths.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); SEGS=$(printf '%s
' "$CMD" | awk 'function fl() { if (iw) { if (sk) sk = 0; else { gsub(/[[:space:];&|()<>]/, "$", w); ob[f] = ob[f] " " w } }; w = ""; iw = 0; wq = 0 } function op(t) { fl(); sk = 0; ob[f] = ob[f] " " t } function fo(b) { f++; fw[f] = w "$"; fk[f] = sk; fq[f] = q; fp[f] = 0; fb[f] = b; ob[f] = ""; w = ""; iw = 0; wq = 0; sk = 0; q = "" } function fc() { fl(); print ob[f]; q = fq[f]; w = fw[f]; sk = fk[f]; f--; iw = 1 } function lx(s, n, i, c, d) { ob[0] = ""; w = ""; iw = 0; wq = 0; sk = 0; q = ""; f = 0; n = length(s); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) { c = substr(s, i, 1); d = substr(s, i + 1, 1); if (q == "s") { if (c == sq) q = ""; else w = w c; continue }; if (q == "a") { if (c == bs) { w = w "$"; i++ } else if (c == sq) q = ""; else w = w c; continue }; if (q == "d" && c == dq) { q = ""; continue }; if (q == "d" && c == bs) { if (d != "" && index("$" bq dq bs, d)) { w = w d; i++ } else w = w c; continue }; if (c == "$" && d == "(") { i++; fo(0); continue }; if (c == bq) { if (f && fb[f] && q == "") fc(); else fo(1); continue }; if (q == "d") { w = w c; continue }; if (c == " " || c == "	") { fl(); continue }; if (c == bs) { if (d != "") { w = w d; i++; iw = 1; wq = 1 }; continue }; if (c == sq || c == dq) { q = (c == sq) ? "s" : "d"; iw = 1; wq = 1; continue }; if (c == "$" && (d == sq || d == dq)) { q = (d == sq) ? "a" : "d"; iw = 1; wq = 1; i++; continue }; if (c == "#" && !iw) break; if (c == "<" || c == ">") { if (iw && !wq && w ~ /^[0-9]+$/) { w = ""; iw = 0 } else fl(); while (d == "<" || d == ">") { i++; d = substr(s, i + 1, 1) }; if (d == "&" || d == "|" || d == "-") { i++; d = substr(s, i + 1, 1) }; if (d == "(") { i++; fo(0) } else sk = 1; continue }; if (c == ";" || c == "&" || c == "|") { op(c); continue }; if (c == "(") { op(c); if (f) fp[f]++; continue }; if (c == ")") { if (f && !fb[f] && !fp[f]) { fc(); continue }; if (f && fp[f]) fp[f]--; op(c); continue }; w = w c; iw = 1 }; while (f > 0) fc(); fl(); print ob[0] } BEGIN { sq = sprintf("%c", 39); dq = sprintf("%c", 34); bs = sprintf("%c", 92); bq = sprintf("%c", 96) } { if (sub(/\$/, "")) { b = b $0; next }; lx(b $0); b = "" } END { if (b != "") lx(b) }' | grep -oE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_.$"-])[Gg][Ii][Tt]([[:space:]]+(-[Cc]|--git-dir|--work-tree|--namespace|--config-env|--attr-source|--shallow-file)[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]][^;&|<>()]*)?($|[;&|<>()])'); [ -n "$SEGS" ] || exit 0; (printf '%s
' "$SEGS" | while IFS= read -r S; do printf '%s
' "$S" | grep -qE '[[:space:]]-[vqdnu46]*f|[[:space:]]\+[^[:space:]]|([[:space:]]|:)((refs/)?heads/)?(main|master)([[:space:]]|$|[;&|<>()])' && exit 2; printf '%s
' "$S" | awk '{ for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { t = $i; sub(/=.*/, "", t); if (t ~ /^--[a-z]/ && (index("--all", t) == 1 || index("--branches", t) == 1 || index("--mirror", t) == 1 || index("--force-with-lease", t) == 1)) b = 1 } } END { exit !b }' && exit 2; case "$S" in *\$*|*[{}]*|*--git-dir*|*--work-tree*) exit 3 ;; esac; printf '%s
' "$S" | grep -qE '[[:space:]](-c|--config-env)([[:space:]=]|$)' && exit 3; case "$CMD" in *GIT_DIR=*|*GIT_WORK_TREE=*|*GIT_CONFIG*|*xargs*) exit 3 ;; esac; CD=$(printf '%s
' "$S" | awk '{ d = "."; for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { if ($i == "push") break; if ($i == "-C" && i < NF) { v = $(i + 1); if (v ~ /^~(/|$)/) v = ENVIRON["HOME"] substr(v, 2); d = (v ~ /^// || d == ".") ? v : d "/" v } }; print d }'); [ "$CD" = . ] || git -C "$CD" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 3; REFS=$(printf '%s
' "$S" | awk '{ sub(/[[:space:];&|<>()]+$/, ""); p = 0; for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i == "push") { p = i; break }; r = 0; for (j = p + 1; j <= NF; j++) { if ($j ~ /^-[vqdnfu46]*o$/ || ($j ~ /^--[a-z][^=]*$/ && (index("--push-option", $j) == 1 || index("--repo", $j) == 1 || index("--receive-pack", $j) == 1 || index("--exec", $j) == 1 || index("--recurse-submodules", $j) == 1))) { j++; continue }; if ($j == "--tags") print $j; if (substr($j, 1, 1) == "-") continue; r++; if (r > 1) print $j } }'); printf '%s
' "$REFS" | while IFS= read -r T; do case "$T" in ":"|*\**) exit 2 ;; ""|--tags|*:*) ;; *) case "$(git -C "$CD" rev-parse --symbolic-full-name "$T" 2>/dev/null)" in refs/heads/main|refs/heads/master) exit 2 ;; esac ;; esac; done || exit 2; case "$(git -C "$CD" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" in main|master) [ -z "$REFS" ] && exit 2 ;; esac; :; done); case $? in 0) exit 0 ;; 3) echo '❌ BLOCKED: Cannot read this git push. Write the branch and any -C directory out literally, with no $, backticks, braces, quoted spaces or shell operators, -c, --config-env, --git-dir, --work-tree, GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_CONFIG or xargs.' >&2 ;; *) echo '❌ BLOCKED: Direct push to main or force push. Create a feature branch and PR.' >&2 ;; esac; exit 2

F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$F" in /*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; D=${F%/*}; while [ -n "$D" ] && [ ! -d "$D" ]; do D=${D%/*}; done; D=${D:-/}; [ "$(git -C "$D" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" = main ] || exit 0; P=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$P" ] && [ "$(git -C "$D" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" != "$P" ] && exit 0; T=${F#"$D"/}; if [ "$(git -C "$D" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ]; then git -C "$D" check-ignore -q -- "$T" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; case "$(git -C "$D" rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null)$T" in AGENTS.md|CLAUDE.md) exit 0 ;; esac; fi; echo '❌ BLOCKED: Cannot edit repo files on main. Allowed: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md. Create a feature branch, or edit the copy in your worktree.' >&2; exit 2

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s\n' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_.-])git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc]|--git-dir|--work-tree|--namespace|--config-env|--attr-source)[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$|[;&|)<>])'; then R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; OUT=$(cd "$R" && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check --output-format concise . 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | tail -20 >&2; echo '❌ BLOCKED: Unformatted files. Run just fix, re-add the files you are committing, then retry.' >&2; exit 2; }; fi; exit 0

IN=$(cat); STOP_ACTIVE=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); if [ "$STOP_ACTIVE" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; RESPONSE=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.last_assistant_message // empty' | tail -200); if printf '%s\n' "$RESPONSE" | grep -qiE 'TODO|FIXME|will implement later|placeholder|stub'; then echo '⚠️ Response contains incomplete markers (TODO/FIXME/placeholder). Consider finishing before stopping.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
